Terrible Experience
Feb 2019 • Friends
First time I wish Google has 0 star in their rating range. 
Strongly not recommended this restaurant!!!!! I was angry until I lost my appetite. This was the first time and the last time I came here. 
1. They don't have receptionist, so when I wanted to ask for details, no one answered. I had to wait long time although not much customer at 6pm. 
2. Let's me sat at the dirty table, and promised to clean immediately. BUT, after 15 mins, no one came to clean it. I MUST called them more than 5 times to clean it. 
3. Another Korean family came after me, but they served them before me. 
4. They said vegetables and dipping sauce were at the conner outside, self service, but when I came, what I saw is empty sauce bow, no vegetables, nothings totally nothings. OK, maybe they haven't refilled it yet. So I tried to walk there every 20 mins 1 time. There was ONE and ONLY ONE time I could get salad, few pieces of sweet potatoes, corn, kimchi. That's all. 
5. About service, it was super terrible. I called the waiter/waitress, they saw me and turned away or "ok, please wait me" and never come until I was angry. 
6. Charcoal wasn't enough, I wanted to add extra but no one care, so my friend told me : "nevermind, we pay and go". 
7. They said it is buffet restaurant, but they gave me a plate of meat with few pieces only. My group had 4 people, and 1 plate of meat. Who will eat????? When we finished 1 plate, must called and waited another 15 mins to get another plate. Why do I have to wait to get meat in buffet restaurant? They didn't gave us steamboat as the menu shown. 
8. When we wanted to pay and left there ASAP before I was going to explode, it took another 20 mins to get the bill. 
9. There was no chopsticks, no spoons until I came other table and took it MYSELF. 
10. The price was not cheap at all for us with the amount of food and service. (Bill below)
